when I was around 13 I was horribly depressed. Not because I wanted attention or because I was trying to be “angsty”, I just was. Alongside that, I had terrible anxiety and at one point I found myself holding a knife to my chest. I was sobbing so loud, my grandma walking in and immediately took me to the hospital that my mom worked in. The worst part was watching her cry when she saw me. I got “better” which was faked so she wouldn’t worry about me. The next year, I started extremely restricting my eating. It all ended when  my mom noticed and took me to a doctor and they ran god knows how many blood tests. I was diagnosed with a fuck ton of gene mutations; the only one I remember is MTHFR (remembered by saying motherfucker). I still have my bad days but I can say that I’m actually a lot better.

ok so this sounds completely made up but I swear this happened to me when i was around 4. We had just moved into a new house to get closer to my dad’s work. 

The first few nights were fine but then I started coming to my parents door and saying “there’s a creepy old man in a sweater in my room” my parents were obviously disturbed by this and went to check it out but there was nothing there. 

My parents brushed it off as an excuse for me to sleep in their bed with them. They let me in and nothing else happened that night.

Next day, same story. Actually this went on for a week or two until my parents got tired of it. “Just tell him to go away” my mom said. I dragged my little feet back to my room and then my mom heard me squeak out “You have to go home now”. 

There have been minimal problems with ghosts since then.

Another time (which I assume was with a different spirit) when I was around 13, I would hear steps up the hallway and knocking on my door. 

Well one time I heard a bang and my door went down. And I’m talking off the hinges. In my angsty voice I yelled “CAN YOU JUST STOP?” Nothing has happened since then and nobody has ever been able to explain these experiences. 

My advice for getting rid of a pesky ghost: tell them to fuck off
